name: Lai zi Yijie de Chulian Shouji
source:
That day wasn’t supposed to be anything special.

Overtime until midnight.
A lukewarm convenience-store meal.
And a secondhand test phone I accidentally took home.

Until I opened the contact list.

There was only one name left.

Amaria.

My first love.
And the girl who had already died.

This is an interactive narrative game centered around phone calls and conversations.

Between reason and obsession, you will uncover the truth behind a call that should never have been answered.
Through dialogue choices and intimate interactions, a forbidden connection slowly reveals what lies beyond the screen.

If she’s truly gone…

Then who is answering the phone?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4433100/The_Phone_from_Another_World_My_First_Love/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
那一天本不该有任何特别之处。

加班到午夜。
一份微温的便利店便当。
还有一部被我不小心错带回家的二手测试手机。

直到我点开了通讯录。

里面只剩下一个名字。

阿玛丽亚。

我的初恋。
也是那个早已离世的女孩。

这是一款围绕手机通话与交谈展开的互动叙事游戏。

在理智与执念之间，你将一步步揭开这通本不该被接起的电话背后的真相。
通过对话抉择与亲密互动，一段禁忌的联结将缓缓揭晓屏幕另一端的秘密。

如果她真的已经不在人世……

那么接电话的人，究竟是谁？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4433100/The_Phone_from_Another_World_My_First_Love/]Steam[/url]]
